arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack detected originating from compromised internal host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), masquerading through partner VPN gateway IP 10.0.5.14. Attack began with Cobalt Strike beaconing (ET TROJAN signature) on 2026-04-09T02:17:33Z, followed by lateral movement attempts and failed Kerberos TGT requests targeting domain services. The source IP 10.0.5.14 was recently unblocked under change request CR-2026-0412 for business integration purposes, which inadvertently exposed the network to an already-compromised internal endpoint. }
